clauses.label: How to win
clauses.quote: Each side has a **Base** with 5 orbs. A Base with no orbs loses. You bring a deck of 16 cards.
clauses.answer: Each side's Base starts with 5 orbs. A Base with no orbs loses. Each deck has 16 cards.

clauses.label: Tributes and troop cost
clauses.quote: **Stars** set a troop's cost. 1 to 4 stars are free. 5 and 6 cost one **tribute**: one of your own troops, sent to the graveyard. 7 and up cost two.
clauses.answer: Troops with 1 to 4 stars are free. 5 or 6 stars cost one tribute: one of your own troops, sent to the graveyard. 7 stars and up cost two tributes.

clauses.label: Opening hand
clauses.quote: Shuffle both decks. Each side draws 4 cards.
clauses.answer: Both decks are shuffled and each side draws 4 cards.

clauses.label: Who goes first
clauses.quote: One side goes first. The side that goes second draws 1 more card.
clauses.answer: One side goes first, and the side that goes second draws 1 more card. This rule does not say how the first side is chosen.

clauses.label: Drawing each turn
clauses.quote: **Draw** one card. On turn 1 the first player does not draw.
clauses.answer: You draw one card each turn, except that the first player does not draw on turn 1.

clauses.label: Hand limit
clauses.quote: If you already hold 6 cards, the card you draw is discarded.
clauses.answer: If you already hold 6 cards when you draw, the drawn card is discarded.

clauses.label: Playing cards
clauses.quote: **Play cards**, in any order, each at most once a turn:
clauses.answer: You may play cards in any order, each of the listed plays at most once a turn.

clauses.label: Spells, gear and locations
clauses.quote: one other card: a spell, a piece of gear or a location;
clauses.answer: One of your plays each turn is one other card: a spell, a piece of gear or a location.

clauses.label: Acting ends card play
clauses.quote: **Act** with each troop once: it attacks or it takes cover. Once any troop acts, you cannot play more cards this turn.
clauses.answer: Each troop acts once a turn by attacking or taking cover. Once any troop acts, you cannot play more cards that turn.

clauses.label: No attacks on turn 1
clauses.quote: Nobody attacks on turn 1.
clauses.answer: Nobody attacks on turn 1.

clauses.label: Resting troops
clauses.quote: **Resting.** A troop that was free cannot attack on the turn it arrives. A troop paid for with a tribute can.
clauses.answer: A troop that was free cannot attack on the turn it arrives. A troop paid for with a tribute can.

clauses.label: Choosing a target and Guard
clauses.quote: **Target.** You choose any enemy troop. If the enemy has a troop with Guard, you must choose a Guard troop.
clauses.answer: You may attack any enemy troop, but if the enemy has a Guard troop you must choose a Guard troop.

clauses.label: Attacking the Base
clauses.quote: **The Base.** You may attack the Base directly only when the enemy has no troops. A direct attack removes orbs equal to your troop's attack.
clauses.answer: You may attack the Base directly only when the enemy has no troops. The Base then loses orbs equal to your troop's attack.

clauses.label: Taking cover
clauses.quote: Instead of attacking, a troop may take cover, even on the turn it arrives. Until your next turn:
clauses.answer: A troop may take cover instead of attacking, even on the turn it arrives. Cover lasts until your next turn.

clauses.label: When traps spring
clauses.quote: When an enemy troop attacks, your oldest face-down trap springs before the attack lands. One trap springs per attack.
clauses.answer: When an enemy troop attacks, your oldest face-down trap springs before the attack lands. Only one trap springs per attack.

clauses.label: When the hand limit is checked
clauses.quote: **A full hand.** The limit is checked only when you draw.
clauses.answer: The hand limit is checked only when you draw.

clauses.label: Running out of turns
clauses.quote: **Running out of turns.** A game still going after turn 80 goes to the side whose Base has more orbs.
clauses.answer: A game still going after turn 80 goes to the side whose Base has more orbs.

clauses.label: Best of three
clauses.quote: **Best of three.** First to win two games. The loser of a game goes first in the next. Between games you may swap cards between your deck and your side deck, one for one.
clauses.answer: Best of three is won by the first to win two games. The loser of a game goes first in the next, and between games you may swap cards with your side deck one for one.

clauses.label: Balance requirement NSB-1: faction win share
clauses.quote: NSB-1: Each faction's win share SHALL be within 45% to 55%, inclusive.
clauses.answer: Balance requirement NSB-1: each faction's win share must be between 45% and 55%, inclusive.

clauses.label: Balance requirement NSB-2: first-seat skew
clauses.quote: NSB-2: The opening player's absolute win-share distance from 50% SHALL grow by at most 1 percentage point versus the baseline.
clauses.answer: Balance requirement NSB-2: the opening player's distance from a 50% win share may grow by at most 1 percentage point versus the baseline.
